identity_lock.summary: A fast, tactile motorcycle-workshop identity where red energy and black technical confidence are humanized by a friendly ninja mascot.
identity_lock.thesis: Motokão communicates precision through a ninja metaphor, urgency through racing red, and trust through real workshop proof.
anti_generic: Do not flatten the identity into a generic red automotive gradient.
Do not mix the canonical 3D Motoko with arbitrary ninja costumes.
Do not replace real workshop proof with stock-tech imagery when proof matters.
Do not let decorative texture overpower the headline or safety information.

focal_moment.name: Mascot gesture or oversized headline
focal_moment.description: A pointed hand, raised fist, large numeral or short headline establishes the message before supporting details.

signature_elements.name: Red scarf tails
signature_elements.anatomy: two red ribbons from the headband
signature_elements.layer_relationship: behind head/shoulders; may cross red circular motif
protection_rules: do not turn them into a cape or weapon

signature_elements.name: White diagonal separator
signature_elements.anatomy: thin or broad white diagonal band
signature_elements.role: separate photo proof from editorial copy
protection_rules: do not use as random decoration in every layout

signature_elements.name: Neon category rings
signature_elements.material: dark/metallic rings with luminous amber line art
protection_rules: keep icons simple at thumbnail scale
avoid adding gradients that reduce line clarity

named_rules.name: Uma ação focal
named_rules.description: Let one gesture, numeral, headline or CTA own the first read.

named_rules.name: Vermelho sinaliza valor
named_rules.description: Use red for urgency, energy, promotions and brand recognition; reserve white/black for hierarchy.

named_rules.name: A prova permanece real
named_rules.description: When the message is technical or institutional, keep the workshop, people, products or store visible under the graphic treatment.

dos: Use red, black and white as the first visual read.
Protect faces, products and critical technical details.
Use texture as depth, not as a substitute for hierarchy.
donts: Do not use Instagram UI colors as brand colors.
Do not add swords, fantasy armor, helmets or unrelated ninja tropes to Motoko.
Do not rely on tiny generated text for logos or legal/price details.
Do not make every post a red wall with no image/content variation.
Do not claim exact motion or breakpoints without recording/source evidence.

recommendations.description: Create an authoritative asset kit with vector logo, approved font files, calibrated color values, mascot master and content templates.
Record or define 3–5 motion primitives: diagonal wipe, mascot reveal, headline rise, neon ring pulse and CTA emphasis, each with reduced-motion fallback.
